purpose: GPU utilization of one run per policy and repeat; collected separately from the 84 performance runs in results/resnet50/comparison and not measured at the same time as them
samples_scope: only samples between the host-received MEASURE_START and MEASURE_END markers; model loading, warm-up and calibration are labelled initialization_or_warmup in gpu_samples.csv and excluded
max_wait_ms_semantics: recorded value is what the policy applied: Adaptive wait = the wait in use, Adaptive immediate = 0 (never waits), Static and SLO-aware = not applicable (null)
